reviews.shade: beplain Sunmuse Tone Up & Correcting Sunscreen 50ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: 結構白くトーンアップしてくれるので、すでに日焼けしていると塗った箇所と塗っていない箇所で差が出てしまうかもしれません。顔用として使用していますが、日焼け止め独特の匂いがほぼ無いのでそこが1番気に入っています。ファンデーションと合わせてもモロモロしません。
reviews.zh: 佢嘅提亮效果幾明顯，如果你本身已經曬黑咗，塗咗同冇塗嘅位置可能會有色差。我當面部防曬用，幾乎冇一般防曬嘅獨特氣味，呢點我最鍾意。配粉底用都唔會甩擦。

reviews.shade: beplain Sunmuse Tone Up & Correcting Sunscreen 50ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text:
It turns out that this wasn't my shade - so a warning to make sure this matches your undertone. It made me look like a corpse.
The texture is thick and creamy, it absorbs pretty fast, no smells.
I gave it to my nieces who are paler and have a cool undertone and they have been using it successfully on sensitive, pale skin. No complaints.
reviews.zh:
結果呢個色號唔啱我——所以提提大家一定要確認夾唔夾自己嘅底調。用完我望落似具屍。
質地厚身creamy，吸收得幾快，冇味。
我轉咗畀我姪女用，佢哋膚色白皙啲、屬於冷調，用喺敏感、白皙嘅皮膚上效果好滿意。冇投訴。

reviews.shade: beplain Sunmuse Tone Up & Correcting Sunscreen 50ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: I was skeptical on the color, but this actually really blended into my skin and this is someone coming from a very tan skin so this was actually pretty good quality. I might consider purchasing it again.
reviews.zh: 原本對個顏色有所保留，但實際用落真係好貼我塊面（我要講明我本身膚色好黝黑），所以質素其實幾好。可能會考慮再買多次。

reviews.shade: beplain Sunmuse Tone Up & Correcting Sunscreen 50ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: Love the consistency, and the tone correcting is great for redness! It almost seems like its leaving a white cast when you first put it on, but it absorbed into the skin really well.
reviews.zh: 鍾意個質地，同埋修色效果對泛紅好有效！初頭搽上去好似會泛白，不過吸收到皮膚嘅效果好好。

reviews.shade: beplain Sunmuse Tone Up & Correcting Sunscreen 50ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text:
Pros: Good for cancelling yellows, helps with toning up as claimed

Cons: very drying for already dry skin, using enough of this to follow recommended sunscreen application will leave you with strong white cast for light-medium or darker skin tone
reviews.zh:
優點：抵消黃色效果好，做到佢聲稱嘅提亮。

缺點：對本身乾燥嘅皮膚嚟講好乾，要搽到符合建議嘅防曬用量嘅話，淺至中等或者更深嘅膚色都會出現明顯泛白。

reviews.shade: beplain Sunmuse Tone Up & Correcting Sunscreen 50ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: The purple tint of this sunscreen helps neutralize yellow undertones. It offers a natural tone-up, is moisturizing, sits well under makeup, and doesn’t break me out.
reviews.zh: 呢支防曬嘅紫色調有助中和黃色底調。做到自然提亮，有保濕，搽完上面搽化妝都好貼，冇令我爆瘡。

reviews.shade: beplain Sunmuse Tone Up & Correcting Sunscreen 50ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: Love it! The tone up color isn’t too bad as other tone ups, but it might differ on tones of skin. It’s moisturizing enough but I do require to use blotting sheets.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意！提亮顏色比起其他提亮產品冇咁誇張，但可能會因應膚色唔同而有分別。保濕度夠，不過我真係需要用吸油面紙。

reviews.shade: beplain Sunmuse Tone Up & Correcting Sunscreen 50ml 1+1 Set
reviews.text: Love this sunscreen! Brightens my skin and also doesn’t irritate my sensitive eyes. Only thing is I have to use it as a second layer because putting on the recommended amount makes me look too pale
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支防曬！用完皮膚提亮，而且唔會刺激到我敏感嘅眼睛。唯一係我要分兩層搽，因為搽到建議嘅分量會顯得太白。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
